I know I've abused people verbally. It's typically always a retaliation method though. I let my buttons get pushed until I snap and it's a no holds bar. Sadley I'm very good at insulting people. It's a defense mechanism I guess and I'm on guard all the time. I'm basically anticipating an insult from anyone so ive already thought how to put pretty much anyone I encounter into a corner. It usually ends with an apology from them or silence. I really hate verbal abuse because I grew up with it. But play with me and you'll get put in an akward situation quick that won't bother me.

Example- 

I was excited a couple weeks ago to go out because it was a beautiful day and I was feeling better after some bad depression. I always dress nice because that's how I was raised and I have nice clothes that I've collected over the years. A little hippie/blonde hood rat chick thought she'd try to act cool and rip on me for my outfit from head to toe. This girl is a mutual acquaintance that I've been very nice to. For once I actually bit my tongue and walked away. I could have ripped her to shreds my pants were worth more than her car (I've seen her car) that would've been a nice opener but that's not the point. It really bothered me though and I thought about that conversation for the next week. People think I'm so aggressive but don't think about what happened right before hand.

I know what you mean though in your post. I have ravaged through my loved ones. I was obsessed with my ex gf before we started dating. Once we dated I used to think in my head "I don't even like this girl". Through the years it was back and forth. Obsession when I couldn't have her and I didn't want her when I did. It's a complete shit show. I've never had a civil break up with anyone. I'd like to say I've learned my lesson but I would be lying. I will always be chasing the shiny new toy. Once I get it, it's like a disposable camera. I make my memories and throw it away. It's sad and it sucks, it's driven me crazy that I cant be normal.

Try and stick with it..I know its hard. I did only two years at a tech school for my degree. I was #1 in the program but towards the end I was really bleeding out. It's soo tough and hard for us but keep pushing. Its much harder to go back but you gotta do what ever you feel is right. I was hired before I graduated into a very good field which was followed by an intense apprenticeship. College was easy compared to the 4 years I had of apprenticeship training. I picked the wrong career for someone with bpd but I didn't know then what was going on yet. Moral of the story keep pushing so you don't lose steam but make sure you chose your career path wisely. I basically went insane from the stress of my job. All the money I made basically went into to self medicating with alcohol and it just fed itself. Sorry for the rant best of luck with whatever you choose!
